note: Global top navigation bar -- renders: GitLab logo, navigation links (Home, Issues, Merge Requests, To-Do List, Help), and user avatar; search input is subtracted as it may echo user queries

Project sidebar navigation -- renders: fixed section labels (Information, Repository, Issues, Merge Requests, Pipelines, Deployments, Infrastructure, Monitor, Analytics, Wiki, Snippets, Settings); the project name header is subtracted as it is user-defined
Breadcrumbs -- renders: navigation path segments (Group, Project, Section) which are structural identifiers for the current context
Issue state tabs -- renders: fixed state labels (Open, Closed, All) with counts
Issue list toolbar -- renders: fixed action buttons (New Issue, Filter, Sort) and search controls; the issue list and bulk update sidebar are subtracted as they contain user-generated content
